description: This file defines the Startup controller class within the Opencart admin marketplace module. It manages startup items, providing functionalities such as listing, enabling, disabling, and deleting startups with proper permission checks and rendering views.

classes.name: Startup
classes.description: Controller class managing startup operations in the admin marketplace section of Opencart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the startup list page with breadcrumb navigation and common layout components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to fetch the list of startups.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of startups from the model and returns the HTML view for display.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected startup entries, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected startup entries, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected startup entries, with permission check and JSON response.
